lines.t: Look up, your Redemption draws nigh
Hear the call of The Most High
The trumpet sounds in all the earth
the pangs increase, as we near the birth
Children of God, come home
The Father calls, to take His own
The Messiah comes, to reign on His throne
Justice and Righteousness will overflow
He calls us out of darkness, into the Light of Life
Heed and repent, give up this fight
Receive His gift, and become a living sacrifice
The time comes quickly when He wipes all tears from our eyes
Children of God, come home
The Father calls, to take His own
The Messiah comes, to reign on His throne
Justice and Righteousness will overflow
Come out from among them
Keep your eyes fixed upon Him
Embrace Him as He is and purify your faith
Give up this life, for our new life awaits
Children of God, come home
The Father calls, to take His own
The Messiah comes, to reign on His throne
Justice and Righteousness will overflow
Come home....
Come home....
